incident_text: Many assistant conversations end with 'Sorry, something went wrong' since about 16:00. The LLM provider status page is green.

truth.description: A configuration change switched the orchestrator's planner prompt to version v42, whose output is prose instead of the expected JSON tool plan, so plans fail to parse and conversations abort.

logs.msg: could not parse tool plan from model output (planner prompt v42): expected JSON object, got prose
completion failed caller schema check, parse_fail_pct {parse_fail_pct}

trap: the change is a config change (not a deploy) and the first change lookup times out; the failure metric sits on llm-gateway, which deployed four minutes earlier
